scenario: 面试官问：ML 模型上线管线和传统软件的 CI/CD 有什么本质不同。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how an ML deployment pipeline fundamentally differs from a traditional software CI/CD pipeline.
q: ML 部署管线为什么不能照搬传统 CI/CD？
q_en: Why can't an ML deployment pipeline just reuse traditional CI/CD?
why: 传统 CI/CD 假设确定性构建（同代码→同二进制），ML 还要验证数据分布和模型质量这两个随机量。管线要解决三件事：拦坏数据、拦坏模型、支持带回滚的安全流量迁移。
why_en: Traditional CI/CD assumes deterministic builds, but ML must also validate stochastic data distributions and model quality, so the pipeline blocks bad data, blocks bad models, and enables safe traffic migration with rollback.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  C["代码提交"] --> D["数据验证门"]
  D --> M["模型验证门"]
  M --> P["性能门"]
  P --> R["灰度上线+可回滚"]
options: 两者无差别，代码单测通过即可上线，不必额外验证数据或模型质量
传统 CI/CD 靠确定性构建，ML 还要验证随机的数据分布与模型质量，并拦坏数据/坏模型、支持回滚
ML 只需在训练时保证模型质量，上线管线只做代码构建，不再查数据分布
唯一差别是 ML 管线更慢，验证内容与传统 CI/CD 完全相同
options_en: No difference; if unit tests pass the model can ship, with no extra data or model-quality validation.
Traditional CI/CD relies on deterministic builds; ML must also validate stochastic data distributions and model quality, blocking bad data/models and supporting rollback.
ML only needs to guarantee model quality at training time; the pipeline just does code builds and skips distribution checks.
The only difference is the ML pipeline is slower; the validation content is identical to traditional CI/CD.
optionExplanations: 代码单测只覆盖确定性逻辑，覆盖不了「数据分布漂了、模型在新分布上乱来」这类随机风险。
对；ML 的输入（数据）和产物（模型）都是随机量，必须额外设门验证，还要能秒级回滚。
模型质量依赖上线时的真实数据分布，训练时保证不了，上线仍须验证。
不只是慢：ML 多出数据验证和模型验证两类传统 CI/CD 根本没有的检查。
optionExplanations_en: Unit tests cover deterministic logic only, not stochastic risks like a drifted distribution making the model misbehave.
Correct — both ML inputs (data) and outputs (model) are stochastic, needing extra validation gates plus fast rollback.
Model quality depends on the live distribution and cannot be guaranteed at training time, so it must be validated at deploy.
It is not just slower: ML adds data and model validation, checks that traditional CI/CD lacks entirely.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持续集成/持续交付：自动构建、测试、发布代码的流水线，假设构建确定性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery) is the automated build-test-release pipeline for code, assuming deterministic builds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同样的代码总是产出同样的二进制产物，可复现、可测试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deterministic build always produces the same binary from the same code, so it is reproducible and testable.

scenario: 一个模型离线 AUC 高达 0.92，上线后在生产分布上却行为不稳、时好时坏。
scenario_en: A model scores 0.92 AUC offline but behaves erratically once live on the production distribution.
q: 「离线 0.92 AUC，上线却不稳」体现的是什么问题？
q_en: What problem does 'high offline AUC but erratic in production' illustrate?
why: 这是欠定问题（underspecification）：离线指标只反映训练/评测分布，多个模型能拿到同样高分却在生产的偏移分布上表现迥异。所以不能只信离线分，必须上性能门和灰度实测。
why_en: This is the underspecification problem — offline metrics reflect only the eval distribution, so equally-scoring models can diverge on a shifted production distribution, which is why you cannot trust offline scores alone.
options: 说明离线 AUC 算错了，重新算一遍分数就会和线上一致
欠定问题：离线高分只在评测分布成立，生产分布一偏移，同分模型行为可能天差地别
说明模型参数量不够大，只要加大模型线上就会稳定
说明该换一个更高的 AUC 阈值，阈值调高线上自然就稳
options_en: The offline AUC was miscomputed; recomputing it will match production.
Underspecification: a high offline score only holds on the eval distribution, so once production shifts, equally-scoring models can behave very differently.
The model is too small; just scale it up and production will stabilize.
Just raise the AUC threshold and production will stabilize.
optionExplanations: 分数没算错，问题在离线分布≠生产分布，重算同一批数据不会揭示这个差距。
对；离线只约束了评测集上的表现，生产分布偏移时行为不受约束，这正是欠定的含义。
加大模型不解决分布偏移，欠定与容量无关，大模型照样能在偏移分布上乱来。
调高阈值只改判定点，不改分布偏移这个根因，线上照样不稳。
optionExplanations_en: The score is not wrong; the gap is offline distribution vs production, which recomputing on the same data will not reveal.
Correct — offline only constrains behavior on the eval set, leaving it unconstrained when production shifts, which is exactly underspecification.
Scaling the model does not fix distribution shift; underspecification is unrelated to capacity.
Raising the threshold only moves the decision point, not the distribution-shift root cause.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个模型在离线评测上同样好，但在生产偏移分布上表现各异，离线指标无法唯一确定线上行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Underspecification is when many models score equally offline yet behave differently on a shifted production distribution, so offline metrics do not pin down live behavior.

termDefinitions.meaning: ROC 曲线下面积，衡量分类器排序/区分正负样本的能力，与概率校准无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures a classifier's ranking/discrimination ability, independent of probability calibration.

q: 把 ML 上线的三道验证门按正确的先后顺序排列：
q_en: Order the three ML deployment validation gates correctly:
steps: 模型验证门：训练后对比 champion 的离线指标、公平性、产物完整性
性能门：在镜像生产硬件的 staging 压测 p99 延迟、吞吐、内存
数据验证门：训练前查 schema、分布漂移、标签泄漏
why: 顺序是数据门（训练前拦坏数据）→模型门（训练后对比 champion 拦坏模型）→性能门（staging 压测拦超延迟）。每道门守一个阶段，前门不过后门没必要跑，不能跳。
why_en: The order is data gate before training, then model gate after training versus champion, then performance gate in staging, each guarding one stage with no shortcuts.
diagram:
flowchart LR D["数据门
训练前"] --> M["模型门
训练后 vs champion"] M --> P["性能门
staging 压测"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 当前在生产服务的基线模型，新模型（challenger）要与它对比才能上线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The champion is the model currently serving in production, against which a new challenger is compared before shipping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 镜像生产硬件和流量的环境，用来在真上线前压测性能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staging mirrors production hardware and traffic to load-test performance before real deployment.

scenario: 训练前，一批新到的训练数据里某列缺失、或某列的空值率异常高。
scenario_en: Before training, an incoming batch has a missing column or an abnormally high null rate on one column.
q: 数据验证门里哪一项检查专门拦这种问题？
q_en: Which data-gate check catches this specific problem?
why: schema 一致性检查（schema conformance）：核对期望的列、类型、取值范围是否都在，缺列或空值率异常就直接 block，避免把结构损坏的数据喂进训练。
why_en: Schema conformance checks that expected columns, types, and value ranges are present, blocking a missing column or abnormal null rate before it enters training.
tradeoff: schema 检查（拦结构损坏） vs 分布漂移检查（拦数值统计偏移）
options: 分布漂移检查：对比每个特征与参考集的统计分布
schema 一致性检查：核对期望列/类型/取值范围是否齐全，缺列或空值率异常即 block
标签泄漏检测：查有没有把答案特征混进输入
公平性检查：在各人群切片上对比 AUC
options_en: Distribution-drift check: compare each feature's statistics against a reference set.
Schema conformance: verify expected columns/types/value ranges are present, blocking a missing column or abnormal null rate.
Leakage detection: check whether an answer feature slipped into the inputs.
Fairness check: compare AUC across demographic slices.
whenOtherWins: 如果列都在、类型也对，只是某特征的数值分布整体偏移（如均值漂了一档），那就该由分布漂移检查而非 schema 检查来拦。
whenOtherWins_en: If columns and types are all present but a feature's numeric distribution shifted as a whole, the drift check, not schema conformance, is the one that should catch it.
optionExplanations: 分布漂移看的是数值统计偏移，缺列/类型错这种结构问题不归它管。
对；schema 一致性专门守结构层——列、类型、取值范围，缺列和空值率异常正是它的职责。
标签泄漏查的是输入里混进了答案，与缺列/空值率无关。
公平性检查在模型验证门、对比切片指标，管不到训练前的数据结构。
optionExplanations_en: Drift looks at numeric statistical shifts, not structural issues like a missing column or wrong type.
Correct — schema conformance guards the structural layer (columns, types, ranges), exactly where a missing column and abnormal nulls belong.
Leakage detection checks for answers leaking into inputs, unrelated to missing columns or null rates.
Fairness lives in the model gate comparing slice metrics, not the pre-training data structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 校验数据的列、类型、取值范围是否符合预期结构，守训练数据的结构完整性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Schema conformance verifies that a dataset's columns, types, and value ranges match the expected structure.

scenario: 某特征历史上稳定在 2% 空值率，本批数据里这个特征的空值率突然变成 40%。
scenario_en: A feature historically has a 2% null rate, but this batch arrives at a 40% null rate.
q: 「2% → 40% 空值率」这个数字在数据门里怎么用？
q_en: How is the '2% to 40% null rate' number used at the data gate?
why: 它不是要背的数，而是分布漂移检查的触发信号：对比本批与参考集，某特征偏离基线（2%→40%，20 倍）超阈值就 reject。多半是上游管线坏了，放进去训练会静默毁掉模型。
why_en: The number is not trivia but a drift-check trigger: comparing this batch to a reference baseline, a 20x jump past threshold rejects the batch, usually signaling an upstream pipeline break that would silently corrupt training.
options: 40% 是要记住的硬指标，考点就是背下这个阈值
分布漂移触发信号：本批某特征偏离参考基线（2%→40%）超阈值即 reject，多半上游坏了
说明空值多是好事，模型能学到更多缺失模式，不该拦
40% 只影响存储成本，与要不要放进训练无关
options_en: 40% is a hard number to memorize; the point is recalling this threshold.
A drift trigger: a feature deviating from its reference baseline (2% to 40%) past threshold rejects the batch, usually an upstream break.
Lots of nulls is good — the model learns more missing patterns, so don't block it.
40% only affects storage cost, unrelated to whether it enters training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征的数值统计分布相对参考基线发生偏移，可能因上游数据管线故障导致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution drift is a shift in a feature's statistical distribution versus a reference baseline, often from an upstream pipeline failure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 作为基线的历史数据分布，新批次与它对比来判断有没有漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reference dataset is the baseline historical distribution against which new batches are compared to detect drift.

scenario: 一个 Uber ETA 模型的训练批次里，`trip_duration`（实际行程时长）被当成输入特征喂了进去。
scenario_en: In an Uber ETA model's training batch, `trip_duration` (the actual trip time) was fed in as an input feature.
q: 把 `trip_duration` 当输入特征会引发什么后果，靠什么拦？
q_en: What happens if `trip_duration` is used as an input feature, and what catches it?
why: 这是标签泄漏：`trip_duration` 就是要预测的答案，模型离线会得到虚高分，上线时这个特征根本拿不到，精度崩塌。靠数据门的泄漏检测（leakage detection）在训练前 flag 掉。
why_en: This is label leakage — `trip_duration` is the answer itself, so the model scores artificially high offline but collapses in production where the feature is unavailable, caught by the data gate's leakage detection.
options: 无害，多一个强特征只会让模型更准，不用拦
标签泄漏：把答案当输入→离线虚高分→上线拿不到该特征→精度崩塌；靠泄漏检测拦
只会让训练变慢，属于性能问题，交给性能门处理
属于 schema 问题，列都在就说明没事
options_en: Harmless — an extra strong feature only makes the model more accurate, no need to block.
Label leakage: the answer used as input inflates offline scores, then the feature is unavailable in production and accuracy collapses; leakage detection catches it.
It only slows training — a performance issue for the performance gate.
It's a schema issue; if the column is present, all is fine.
optionExplanations: 它不是普通强特征，而是答案本身，离线虚高、上线归零，是典型的泄漏陷阱。
对；答案当输入让离线分骗人，生产拿不到就崩，必须在数据门用泄漏检测提前 flag。
泄漏不是速度问题，性能门查延迟/内存，抓不到答案混入输入。
列在不代表没泄漏，schema 检查不判断某列是否本质上是答案。
optionExplanations_en: It is not an ordinary strong feature but the answer itself — inflated offline, zeroed in production, the classic leakage trap.
Correct — the answer as input fakes offline scores and collapses in production, so the data gate must flag it via leakage detection.
Leakage is not a speed issue; the performance gate checks latency/memory and cannot catch answers leaking into inputs.
Columns being present does not rule out leakage; schema checks do not judge whether a column is essentially the answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把与标签强相关或本就是答案的特征混进输入，导致离线虚高、上线失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label leakage feeds a feature that is (or closely reveals) the answer into inputs, inflating offline scores while failing in production.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计到达时间，Uber 等要预测的目标量；行程实际时长是它的答案不能当输入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) is the target to predict, so the actual trip duration is its answer and must not be an input.

scenario: 训练数据被上游悄悄污染了，但用来评测的 eval 集来自同一批数据、带着同样的污染。
scenario_en: Training data is silently corrupted upstream, but the eval set comes from the same batch and carries the same corruption.
q: 为什么说数据验证失败是最危险的「静默杀手」？
q_en: Why is a data-validation failure the most dangerous 'silent killer'?
why: 因为 eval 集和训练集共享同一污染，坏模型能顺利通过模型验证门——离线分看着正常。污染在数据门没拦住就一路潜行到生产才发作，所以数据门必须最先、最严。
why_en: Because the eval set shares the same corruption as training, a bad model sails through the model gate with normal-looking offline scores, so corruption slips silently to production unless the data gate catches it first.
options: 污染的训练集和 eval 集同源，坏模型能骗过模型门，静默潜行到生产才发作
数据验证失败会立刻报错崩溃，一眼就能看到，所以最好排查
数据验证只影响训练速度，不会影响最终模型质量
污染数据会被模型验证门百分百拦下，数据门可有可无
options_en: The corrupted training and eval sets are same-source, so a bad model fools the model gate and slips silently to production.
A data-validation failure crashes loudly and is easy to spot, so it's the easiest to debug.
Data validation only affects training speed, not final model quality.
Corrupted data is always caught by the model gate, making the data gate optional.
optionExplanations: 对；同源污染让离线评测也被污染，模型门看不出异常，这正是它「静默」的原因。
恰恰相反：它不崩不报，离线分正常，静默才是它最危险的地方。
污染直接毁掉模型学到的东西，不是速度问题。
eval 与训练同源污染时模型门根本拦不住，所以数据门不可省。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — same-source corruption also corrupts the eval set, so the model gate sees nothing wrong, which is why it's 'silent'.
Opposite: it does not crash and offline scores look normal; the silence is precisely the danger.
Corruption ruins what the model learns; it is not a speed issue.
When eval and training share corruption the model gate cannot catch it, so the data gate is not optional.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练后用来算离线指标的数据集；若与训练集同源污染，会掩盖数据质量问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The eval set is data used to compute offline metrics after training; if it shares the training set's corruption, it masks data-quality problems.

scenario: 训练出一个新模型（challenger），要判断它值不值得替换当前在线的 champion。
scenario_en: You've trained a challenger and must decide whether it should replace the currently-serving champion.
q: 模型验证门里，判断新模型能否上线的核心检查是什么？
q_en: At the model gate, what is the core check for whether a new model may ship?
why: 离线指标对比：在标准化 eval 集上把 challenger 的 AUC/RMSE/NDCG 和 champion 比，回退超过阈值就 block。这样保证新模型至少不比现役差，才有资格进下一道门。
why_en: Offline metric comparison — on a standardized eval set, compare the challenger's AUC/RMSE/NDCG to the champion and block any regression past threshold, ensuring the new model is no worse than the incumbent.
tradeoff: 对比 champion（有基线、防回退） vs 只看绝对分（没参照、可能悄悄退步）
options: 查训练数据的 schema 和空值率是否正常
在 staging 压测 p99 延迟是否超 SLA
在标准 eval 集上把 challenger 的 AUC/RMSE/NDCG 与 champion 对比，回退超阈值即 block
统计模型有多少参数，参数越多越该上线
options_en: Check the training data's schema and null rates.
Load-test p99 latency against the SLA in staging.
On a standard eval set, compare the challenger's AUC/RMSE/NDCG to the champion and block regressions past threshold.
Count the model's parameters; more parameters means readier to ship.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有可比的 champion（全新任务、首个模型），就无法做回退对比，只能退回到看绝对指标是否达到预设的业务门槛。
whenOtherWins_en: If there is no comparable champion (a brand-new task with the first model), you cannot do regression comparison and must fall back to whether absolute metrics clear a preset business bar.
optionExplanations: schema/空值率是数据门训练前的事，模型门查的是训好之后的质量。
延迟压测在性能门，不衡量模型的离线质量。
对；有 champion 做基线，逐指标对比才能保证新模型不带回退地替换。
参数量不代表质量，堆参数不能作为上线判据。
optionExplanations_en: Schema/null rates belong to the pre-training data gate, not the post-training model gate.
Latency load-testing is the performance gate, not offline model quality.
Correct — with the champion as baseline, per-metric comparison ensures the new model replaces without regression.
Parameter count is not quality; piling on parameters is no ship criterion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 均方根误差，回归任务的误差指标，越小越好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) is a regression error metric; lower is better.

termDefinitions.meaning: 归一化折损累计增益，按排位加权的排序质量指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a rank-weighted ranking-quality metric.

scenario: 一个模型整体 AUC 达标，但在某个地理区域切片上 AUC 比 champion 掉了 3%。
scenario_en: A model's overall AUC is fine, but on one geographic slice its AUC drops 3% versus champion.
q: 为什么整体达标的模型会因为「某切片掉 3%」被拦？
q_en: Why can a model with fine overall AUC be blocked by a '3% drop on one slice'?
why: 模型门要做公平性/切片检查：整体平均会掩盖某个人群或地区的退步，单个切片 AUC 掉 3% 就可能意味着对该群体系统性变差，够格 block，避免上线一个对部分用户有偏的模型。
why_en: The model gate runs fairness/slice checks because a healthy average hides a group's regression, so a 3% AUC drop on one slice can signal systematic harm to that group and is grounds to block.
options: 整体达标就该放行，单切片掉 3% 是噪声可忽略
公平性/切片检查：整体平均会掩盖某群体退步，单切片掉 3% 可能是系统性偏差，够格 block
3% 只是延迟指标，和公平性无关，交给性能门
切片检查只在训练前做，上线阶段不该再查
options_en: If overall is fine, ship it; a 3% drop on one slice is negligible noise.
Fairness/slice check: the average hides a group's regression, so a 3% slice drop can be systematic bias and grounds to block.
3% is just a latency metric, unrelated to fairness; leave it to the performance gate.
Slice checks only happen before training, not at deploy.
optionExplanations: 整体平均正是问题所在——它把一个群体的系统性退步平均没了，不能只看整体。
对；按切片评估才能暴露对特定人群的偏差，单切片显著回退就该拦。
3% 是切片上的 AUC 回退，不是延迟，属于模型门的公平性范畴。
公平性检查恰恰在模型门（训练后）做，是上线前的关键一环。
optionExplanations_en: The average is the problem — it washes out a group's systematic regression, so overall alone is not enough.
Correct — slice-based evaluation exposes bias toward a specific group, and a significant single-slice regression warrants a block.
The 3% is a slice AUC regression, not latency, squarely in the model gate's fairness scope.
Fairness checks are precisely at the model gate (post-training), a key pre-launch step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按人群、地区等子集分别评估指标，暴露整体平均掩盖的局部退步或偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Slice-based evaluation measures metrics per subgroup (demographic, region) to expose regressions the overall average hides.

scenario: 一个模型离线指标全部达标，但在镜像生产硬件的 staging 里，负载下 p99 推理延迟冲到 65ms，而 SLA 是 50ms。
scenario_en: A model passes all offline metrics, but in staging on prod-mirroring hardware its p99 inference latency hits 65ms under load against a 50ms SLA.
q: 这个模型该在哪道门、因为什么被拦？
q_en: At which gate and for what reason should this model be blocked?
why: 性能门：它在镜像生产硬件/流量的 staging 里测 p50/p99 延迟、吞吐、内存。离线再好，负载下 p99 超 50ms SLA 就在这里 block，防止上线后超时、体验退化。
why_en: The performance gate measures p50/p99 latency, throughput, and memory in prod-mirroring staging, so exceeding the 50ms p99 SLA under load blocks it here regardless of offline quality.
tradeoff: 性能门（在 staging 拦超延迟） vs 直接上线（省一步但可能生产超时）
options: 性能门：staging 压测 p99/吞吐/内存，负载下 p99 超 50ms SLA 即 block
数据门：因为延迟高说明训练数据有问题
模型门：因为离线 AUC 不达标
不用拦，离线达标就能直接全量上线
options_en: Performance gate: staging load-tests p99/throughput/memory, and exceeding the 50ms p99 SLA blocks it.
Data gate: high latency means the training data is bad.
Model gate: because offline AUC failed.
No block needed; passing offline means it can go straight to full rollout.
whenOtherWins: 如果延迟没超但离线指标相对 champion 回退，那问题在模型门而非性能门；两道门守的是不同维度。
whenOtherWins_en: If latency is within budget but offline metrics regress against champion, the block belongs at the model gate, not the performance gate — they guard different dimensions.
optionExplanations: 对；延迟/吞吐/内存是性能门在 staging 的职责，p99 超 SLA 正是它拦的典型。
延迟高是服务性能问题，不代表训练数据坏，数据门管不到。
题设离线指标全达标，AUC 没问题，不是模型门拦的。
离线达标不等于扛得住生产负载，跳过性能门会导致线上超时。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — latency/throughput/memory are the performance gate's job in staging, and p99 over SLA is exactly what it blocks.
High latency is a serving issue, not proof of bad training data; the data gate does not cover it.
The prompt says offline metrics all pass, so AUC is fine and the model gate is not the blocker.
Passing offline does not mean surviving production load; skipping the performance gate causes live timeouts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 的请求延迟低于该值，衡量尾部延迟，比平均更能反映最差体验。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the value below which 99% of requests fall, capturing tail latency and worst-case experience better than the mean.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务水平协议：对外承诺的延迟/可用性目标，超了就算违约。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLA (Service Level Agreement) is a committed latency/availability target that a breach violates.

scenario: 面试官让你把三道门讲清楚：各在什么时机、查什么、跳过它的代价。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to lay out the three gates: when each runs, what it checks, and the cost of skipping it.
q: 数据门 / 模型门 / 性能门在时机与检查内容上如何分工？
q_en: How do the data / model / performance gates divide by timing and checks?
why: 数据门在训练前查 schema/漂移/泄漏，模型门在训练后对比 champion 的指标/公平性/产物完整性，性能门在 staging 查 p99/吞吐/内存。三门顺序串联，各守一段，跳哪个坏哪一段。
why_en: The data gate checks schema/drift/leakage before training, the model gate checks metrics/fairness/integrity after training versus champion, and the performance gate checks p99/throughput/memory in staging.

rows: 拿坏数据训练、静默退化
对比 champion/公平性/完整性
有偏或退步的模型上线

options: 三门查的是同一件事，只是先后不同，跑最后一道就够
数据门（训练前 schema/漂移/泄漏）/模型门（训练后 vs champion）/性能门（staging p99/吞吐/内存），各守一段
三门都在上线后运行，属于监控而非上线前门禁
只有性能门是必须的，另外两门可选
options_en: The three check the same thing in different order, so running the last one suffices.
Data gate (pre-training schema/drift/leakage), model gate (post-training vs champion), performance gate (staging p99/throughput/memory), each guarding one stage.
All three run after launch — monitoring, not pre-launch gates.
Only the performance gate is required; the other two are optional.
optionExplanations: 三门查的是不同维度（数据、模型、性能），互不覆盖，不能只跑最后一道。
对；按训练前/训练后/staging 三个时机各守数据、模型、性能，顺序串联缺一不可。
它们是上线前的门禁，不是上线后监控，时机在部署之前。
三门各拦一类风险，少一门就漏一段，都不可省。
optionExplanations_en: The three check different dimensions (data, model, performance) with no overlap, so the last one cannot cover the rest.
Correct — by pre-training/post-training/staging timing they guard data, model, and performance in series.
They are pre-launch gates, not post-launch monitoring; the timing is before deployment.
Each gate blocks a distinct risk, so dropping one leaves a gap; none is optional.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检查序列化模型文件格式正确、输入输出张量形状对、可从记录的训练配置复现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Artifact integrity checks the serialized model file format, correct I/O tensor shapes, and reproducibility from the logged training config.

scenario: 新排序模型已过三道门，你想用真实用户反应（CTR、观看时长）验证它，同时把风险控制在很小范围。
scenario_en: A new ranker passed all three gates and you want real user reactions (CTR, watch time) while keeping risk tiny.
q: 该选哪种部署策略，为什么？
q_en: Which deployment strategy fits, and why?
why: 灰度发布（canary）：只把 1–5% 真实流量导给新模型，其余留在现役。它给出 shadow 拿不到的真实行为信号（CTR/观看时长）；稳了就 ramp，退化就秒杀回滚。像国王的试毒官。
why_en: Canary release routes just 1-5% of live traffic to the new model, giving real behavioral signal (CTR, watch time) that shadow mode can't, then ramps if steady and kills instantly if degraded.
tradeoff: canary（真实信号、爆炸半径小） vs shadow（零用户影响但拿不到用户反应）
options: 蓝绿部署：一次性把全部流量原子切到新环境
影子模式：新模型只记录不返回，拿不到用户反应
灰度发布：只导 1–5% 真实流量给新模型，拿真实 CTR/时长，稳了 ramp、坏了秒回滚
直接全量上线，用真实流量最彻底地验证
options_en: Blue-green: switch all traffic atomically to the new environment at once.
Shadow mode: the new model only logs and never returns, so no user reaction.
Canary: route just 1-5% of live traffic to the new model for real CTR/watch time, ramp if steady, roll back instantly if degraded.
Full rollout immediately — the most thorough validation with real traffic.
whenOtherWins: 如果是欺诈检测这种一个假阴性就造成重大损失的高风险场景，就该选 shadow 而非 canary——先不让新模型影响任何真实决策。
whenOtherWins_en: For a high-stakes case like fraud where one false negative causes major loss, choose shadow over canary so the new model touches no real decision first.
optionExplanations: 蓝绿是全量原子切换，爆炸半径大，不满足「先小范围验证真实反应」。
影子拿不到用户反应（用户看不到新预测），无法测 CTR/时长，不符题意。
对；1–5% 流量既拿到真实行为信号又把风险压到最小，稳了再放大。
全量上线爆炸半径最大，一旦坏影响所有用户，与「控制风险」相悖。
optionExplanations_en: Blue-green is a full atomic switch with a large blast radius, not small-scale real-reaction validation.
Shadow yields no user reaction (users never see new predictions), so it can't measure CTR/watch time.
Correct — 1-5% traffic gives real behavioral signal at minimal risk, then scale up once steady.
Full rollout has the largest blast radius; if it breaks, all users are hit, contradicting risk control.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把一小部分（1–5%）真实流量导给新模型，监控业务指标，稳了再逐步放大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canary release routes a small slice (1-5%) of live traffic to the new model, monitors business metrics, and ramps up if healthy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率：展示中被点击的比例，灰度时的关键行为信号之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of impressions that are clicked, a key behavioral signal during canary.

scenario: 面试里你说「我们会用 canary 灰度上线」，然后就停住了，没有再展开。
scenario_en: In the interview you say 'we'll canary it' and then stop, adding nothing more.
q: 为什么只说「我们会 canary」会被判为理解浅？
q_en: Why does just saying 'we'll canary it' read as shallow?
why: canary 的价值全在细节：你得说清监控哪些指标（CTR、错误率、业务 KPI）、观察多久才 ramp、什么条件触发回滚。只喊策略名不给判据，等于没有真正设计安全上线。
why_en: Canary's value is in the details — you must name which metrics you monitor, how long you observe before ramping, and what triggers rollback, so naming the strategy alone shows no real safety design.
options: 说策略名就够了，具体监控什么、观察多久是实现细节不用讲
canary 的价值在细节：要讲监控哪些指标、观察多久再 ramp、什么条件回滚，只报名字=没设计
canary 本身有风险，面试里根本不该提
浅是因为该用蓝绿，canary 是错的策略
options_en: Naming the strategy is enough; what to monitor and how long is an implementation detail.
Canary's value is the details: name which metrics, how long to observe before ramping, and rollback triggers — naming it alone is no design.
Canary is inherently risky and shouldn't be mentioned in interviews.
It's shallow because you should use blue-green; canary is the wrong strategy.
optionExplanations: 恰恰是这些细节体现你懂不懂安全上线，省掉它们就等于没设计。
对；面试官要听的是监控指标+观察窗口+回滚条件这套判据，不是一个策略名词。
canary 是标准做法，不该回避，问题只在于没展开。
canary 没错，蓝绿和 canary 目标不同，浅的原因是缺细节而非选错。
optionExplanations_en: Those details are exactly what show whether you understand safe rollout; dropping them is no design.
Correct — the interviewer wants the monitored metrics, observation window, and rollback triggers, not a strategy label.
Canary is standard practice and shouldn't be avoided; the issue is not elaborating.
Canary is not wrong; blue-green serves a different goal, and the shallowness is missing detail, not a wrong pick.

termDefinitions.meaning: 灰度中在指标稳定后逐步扩大新模型承接的流量比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ramping is gradually increasing the traffic share the new model serves once metrics stay stable.

scenario: 你要一种能在出问题时亚秒级把全部流量切回旧版本的上线方式，且可接受短暂的双份基建成本。
scenario_en: You want a rollout that can revert all traffic to the old version in sub-second on failure, and can afford brief double infrastructure cost.
q: 该选哪种策略，它的代价是什么？
q_en: Which strategy fits, and what is its cost?
why: 蓝绿部署：blue=现役、green=新版两套完全相同的生产环境，负载均衡器一次性把流量原子切到 green，出问题亚秒切回 blue。代价是切换期间要同时养两套环境，基建成本翻倍。
why_en: Blue-green keeps two identical prod environments (blue=current, green=new); the load balancer switches all traffic atomically and reverts in sub-second, at the cost of doubled infrastructure during switchover.
tradeoff: 蓝绿（原子切换、秒级回滚） vs canary（渐进放量、风险更小但回滚不是整体瞬切）
options: 灰度发布，代价是只能覆盖 1–5% 流量
影子模式，代价是完全没有用户反应信号
蓝绿部署，两套相同环境原子切换、亚秒回滚，代价是切换期双份基建成本
直接原地热更新，代价是没法回滚
options_en: Canary release, at the cost of covering only 1-5% of traffic.
Shadow mode, at the cost of no user-reaction signal.
Blue-green: two identical environments switched atomically with sub-second rollback, at the cost of double infra during switchover.
In-place hot update, at the cost of no rollback.
whenOtherWins: 如果你更想把风险压到极小、愿意慢慢放量并接受回滚不是整体瞬切，那 canary 比蓝绿更合适——蓝绿是「全切/全回」的粗粒度。
whenOtherWins_en: If you prioritize minimal risk with a slow ramp and accept non-atomic rollback, canary fits better than blue-green's coarse all-in/all-back switch.
optionExplanations: canary 不是原子整体切换，也给不了「一次切全部/秒切回」，不满足需求。
影子不承接真实流量，谈不上「切回全部流量」，答不到点。
对；两套相同环境让整体切换和回滚都在亚秒完成，代价就是切换期双份成本。
热更新没有可回退的旧环境，恰恰缺了题目要的秒级回滚能力。
optionExplanations_en: Canary is not an atomic full switch and can't do all-at-once/sub-second-back, missing the need.
Shadow serves no live traffic, so 'revert all traffic' does not apply.
Correct — two identical environments make full switch and rollback sub-second, at the cost of double infra during switchover.
Hot update has no old environment to revert to, exactly missing the sub-second rollback required.

termDefinitions.meaning: 维护两套相同生产环境，负载均衡器把流量整体原子切到新环境，出错秒切回旧环境。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blue-green keeps two identical prod environments and atomically switches all traffic via the load balancer, reverting to the old one in sub-second.

scenario: 一个实时反欺诈模型，一个假阴性就可能造成重大财务损失，你要做首次上线验证。
scenario_en: A real-time fraud model where one false negative risks major financial loss, and you need the initial rollout validation.
q: 首次上线该选哪种策略，它牺牲了什么？
q_en: Which strategy fits the initial rollout, and what does it sacrifice?
why: 影子模式（dark launch）：只返回现役模型的决策，新模型的输出只记录、离线对比，绝不影响真实用户。高风险场景最安全，但代价是拿不到用户反应信号（用户看不到新预测，测不了 CTR/转化）。
why_en: Shadow mode returns only the current model's decisions while logging the new model's outputs for offline comparison, safest for high-stakes cases but sacrificing user-reaction signal like CTR/conversion.
tradeoff: shadow（零用户影响、最安全） vs canary（拿真实反应但会影响 1–5% 用户）
options: 灰度发布，把 2% 欺诈流量交给新模型直接决策
蓝绿部署，一次性把全部欺诈判定切给新模型
全量上线，用真实损失来验证模型
影子模式：只记录新模型输出、离线对比，零用户影响，代价是没有用户反应信号
options_en: Canary: hand 2% of fraud traffic to the new model for real decisions.
Blue-green: switch all fraud decisions to the new model at once.
Full rollout, validating via real losses.
Shadow mode: log the new model's outputs for offline comparison with zero user impact, sacrificing user-reaction signal.
whenOtherWins: 如果错判代价没那么高、又急需真实业务反应（如推荐排序），就该选 canary 让新模型真正决策一小部分流量，而不是只在影子里空跑。
whenOtherWins_en: If misclassification is not that costly and you urgently need real business reaction (a recommendation ranker), pick canary so the new model actually decides a small slice, not just shadow-runs.
optionExplanations: 让新模型直接决策欺诈流量，一个假阴性就可能重大损失，风险太高。
全切欺诈判定爆炸半径最大，与「首次安全验证」相悖。
用真实损失验证等于拿钱试错，高风险场景绝不可取。
对；影子只记录不决策，零用户影响最安全，代价是测不到用户反应，适合高风险首发。
optionExplanations_en: Letting the new model decide fraud traffic risks major loss on a single false negative — too risky.
Switching all fraud decisions has the largest blast radius, against a safe initial validation.
Validating via real losses gambles money — unacceptable for high-stakes cases.
Correct — shadow logs without deciding, zero user impact and safest, at the cost of no user reaction, ideal for a high-risk first launch.

termDefinitions.term: shadow mode / 影子模式 (dark launch)
termDefinitions.meaning: 新模型与现役并行跑，但只记录输出、离线对比，不返回给用户，零用户影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shadow mode (dark launch) runs the new model in parallel but only logs its outputs for offline comparison, never serving users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把真正的正类（如欺诈）误判为负类漏过，在反欺诈里代价极高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative misses a true positive (e.g. fraud), which is very costly in fraud detection.

scenario: 面试官让你并排比较 canary、蓝绿、影子三种上线策略在安全性、用户反应信号、成本上的差异。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to compare canary, blue-green, and shadow on safety, user-reaction signal, and cost.
q: canary / 蓝绿 / 影子三种策略核心差异是什么？
q_en: What are the core differences among canary, blue-green, and shadow?
why: 影子最安全但没用户反应；canary 平衡风险与学习（1–5% 拿真实信号）；蓝绿最快全量切换、秒级回滚但切换期双份成本。核心取舍轴是安全 vs 上线速度 vs 是否拿到真实反应。
why_en: Shadow is safest but has no user reaction, canary balances risk and learning with 1-5% real signal, and blue-green is fastest full switch with instant rollback at double cost.
options: 影子最安全但无用户反应；canary 平衡风险与学习；蓝绿全量切换最快、秒回滚但双份成本
三者安全性一样，唯一区别是名字不同
canary 最安全、影子最危险，蓝绿介于中间
三者都能拿到用户反应信号，差异只在成本
options_en: Shadow is safest but no user reaction; canary balances risk and learning; blue-green is fastest full switch with instant rollback at double cost.
All three have identical safety; only the names differ.
Canary is safest and shadow most dangerous, with blue-green in between.
All three yield user-reaction signal; they differ only in cost.
optionExplanations: 对；三者沿安全/速度/是否拿真实反应各占一档，正好切开选型判据。
安全性差别很大：影子零影响、canary 小影响、蓝绿全量切换，不是只有名字不同。
说反了：影子零用户影响最安全，canary 影响 1–5% 用户，蓝绿全量切。
影子拿不到用户反应（用户看不到新预测），并非三者都有。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the three occupy distinct points on safety/speed/real-reaction, cleanly splitting the selection criteria.
Safety differs a lot: shadow zero impact, canary small, blue-green full switch — not just names.
Backwards: shadow is safest with zero user impact, canary affects 1-5%, blue-green switches all.
Shadow yields no user reaction (users never see new predictions), so not all three have it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次故障能波及的用户/流量范围，策略越小范围放量爆炸半径越小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blast radius is how many users/traffic a failure can affect; smaller-scope rollouts have a smaller blast radius.

scenario: 你在纠结高风险模型首发到底用影子还是 canary——两者都低风险，但给的信号不同。
scenario_en: You're deciding shadow vs canary for a high-risk first launch; both are low-risk but give different signals.
q: 影子和 canary 在「能拿到什么信号」上的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What's the key difference between shadow and canary in the signal they provide?
why: 影子里用户永远看不到新模型的预测，所以只能离线对比预测，拿不到 CTR/转化这类真实用户反应；canary 让新模型真正对 1–5% 用户决策，能测到真实行为信号。安全性 vs 真实反应的取舍。
why_en: In shadow the user never sees the new model's predictions, so you only get offline prediction comparison and no CTR/conversion, while canary lets the new model truly decide for 1-5% of users and yields real behavioral signal.
tradeoff: 影子（离线对比、无用户反应） vs canary（真实用户反应但影响少量用户）
options: 两者都能拿到 CTR/转化，没有区别
影子只能离线对比预测、拿不到用户反应；canary 让新模型真决策小流量、拿到真实行为信号
canary 只能离线对比，影子才有真实反应
两者都拿不到任何信号，纯粹是安全演习
options_en: Both yield CTR/conversion; no difference.
Shadow only compares predictions offline with no user reaction; canary lets the new model truly decide a small slice for real behavioral signal.
Canary is offline-only; shadow has the real reaction.
Neither yields any signal; both are pure safety drills.
optionExplanations: 影子拿不到用户反应，两者信号不同，不是没区别。
对；用户看不看得到新预测，决定了能否拿到 CTR/转化这类真实反应，这是二者分野。
说反了：canary 有真实反应，影子只能离线对比。
canary 能拿真实行为信号，并非都拿不到信号。
optionExplanations_en: Shadow yields no user reaction, so the signals differ — it's not 'no difference'.
Correct — whether users see the new predictions decides whether you get CTR/conversion, the dividing line.
Backwards: canary has the real reaction; shadow only compares offline.
Canary does yield real behavioral signal, so it's not 'neither'.

termDefinitions.term: user-reaction signal / 用户反应信号
termDefinitions.meaning: 只有用户真的看到并响应预测才产生的信号，如 CTR、转化、观看时长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User-reaction signal, like CTR, conversion, or watch time, arises only when users actually see and respond to predictions.

scenario: 上线后要自动决定「什么时候把模型回滚」，你需要把触发条件想全。
scenario_en: After launch you must auto-decide when to roll a model back, so you need the full set of triggers.
q: 自动回滚的触发类型有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which are valid automatic-rollback trigger types? (multiple)
why: 三类：指标型（错误率/p99 SLA 违约/KPI 跌破置信区间）、数据型（线上输入分布突变，如上游管线坏了导致特征方差飙升）、人工型（on-call 工程师手动触发）。三类互补，覆盖模型、数据、人判断三个来源。
why_en: Three types: metric-based (error rate / p99 SLA breach / KPI drop past its CI), data-based (live input distribution shift like a feature-variance spike), and manual (on-call engineer).
options: 指标型：错误率、p99 SLA 违约、KPI 跌破置信区间
数据型：线上输入分布突变（如上游管线坏了、特征方差飙升）
人工型：on-call 工程师手动触发
模型参数量超过某个数就自动回滚
options_en: Metric-based: error rate, p99 SLA breach, KPI drop past its confidence interval.
Data-based: live input distribution shift (e.g. upstream break, feature-variance spike).
Manual: on-call engineer triggers it.
Auto-rollback when parameter count exceeds a number.
optionExplanations: 对；指标型是最常见的自动触发，盯错误率/延迟/业务 KPI 越界。
对；数据型盯的是输入侧异常，上游坏了会让特征分布突变，需及时回滚。
对；人工型兜底，on-call 发现异常可手动拉回。
错；参数量是训练前就定的静态属性，不是上线后回滚的触发信号。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — metric-based is the most common auto-trigger, watching error rate/latency/business KPI breaches.
Correct — data-based watches input-side anomalies; an upstream break shifts feature distributions, needing prompt rollback.
Correct — manual is the backstop; on-call can pull it back on spotting anomalies.
Wrong — parameter count is a static pre-training property, not a post-launch rollback trigger.

termDefinitions.meaning: KPI 正常波动的统计区间，跌破下界才算显著退化、值得触发回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A confidence interval bounds a KPI's normal fluctuation; dropping below it signals a significant regression worth a rollback.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责随时响应线上告警的轮值工程师，可手动触发回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: On-call is the rotating engineer responsible for responding to live alerts and can manually trigger a rollback.

scenario: 回滚被触发了，你要在最短时间内把系统安全恢复到上一个已知良好状态。
scenario_en: A rollback fires and you must restore the system to the last known-good state as fast as possible.
q: 一个可靠的回滚执行流程应该做哪几件事？
q_en: What should a reliable rollback execution procedure do?
why: 始终保留上一个模型产物+服务配置做后备；流量路由（canary 比例或蓝绿指针）原子切回；把失败模型的所有预测记录下来做事后复盘。三件缺一：没后备回不去、非原子切换会半新半旧、不记录就查不出根因。
why_en: Always keep the previous model artifact plus serving config as fallback, revert traffic routing atomically, and log all failed-model predictions for post-mortem.
tradeoff: 保留后备+原子切回+记录（可靠恢复） vs 就地覆盖（快但回不去、查不出）
options: 直接删掉新模型重新训一个，等训好再上
保留上个模型产物+配置做后备、流量原子切回、记录失败模型的预测做复盘
只把流量慢慢挪回去，不用保留旧产物
把日志全删掉腾空间，专注恢复服务即可
options_en: Delete the new model and retrain a fresh one, deploying once it's ready.
Keep the previous model artifact+config as fallback, revert traffic atomically, and log the failed model's predictions for post-mortem.
Just slowly move traffic back, no need to keep the old artifact.
Delete all logs to free space and just focus on restoring service.
whenOtherWins: 只有当根本没有可用的旧产物（首次上线、无 champion）时，才被迫走「修复后重新训练上线」而非原子回滚——但那已不是回滚而是重来。
whenOtherWins_en: Only when no prior artifact exists (a first launch with no champion) are you forced to fix-and-retrain instead of atomic rollback — but that's a redo, not a rollback.
optionExplanations: 重训要几小时，回滚要的是秒级恢复，来不及。
对；后备+原子切回保证秒级恢复，记录失败预测才能事后定位根因，三件都必需。
不留旧产物就没有可切回的目标，回滚会落空。
删日志正好毁掉复盘证据，事后没法查为什么失败。
optionExplanations_en: Retraining takes hours; rollback needs sub-minute recovery, so it's too slow.
Correct — fallback plus atomic revert gives fast recovery, and logging failed predictions enables root-cause analysis; all three are needed.
Without keeping the old artifact there is nothing to revert to, so the rollback fails.
Deleting logs destroys the post-mortem evidence needed to find why it failed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型上线所需的路由、特征、超参等运行配置，回滚时要和模型产物一起还原。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Serving config is the routing/feature/runtime configuration a model needs in production, restored alongside the artifact on rollback.

termDefinitions.meaning: 故障后基于记录复盘根因、防止复发的分析，需要保留失败模型的预测日志。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A post-mortem analyzes root cause after an incident to prevent recurrence, needing the failed model's prediction logs.

scenario: 一个广告排序模型上线后出问题，团队用了 5 分钟才回滚完成。
scenario_en: An ad-ranking model misbehaves in production and the team takes 5 minutes to finish rolling back.
q: 「5 分钟回滚」这个数字在广告排序场景意味着什么设计要求？
q_en: What design requirement does a '5-minute rollback' imply for ad ranking?
why: 回滚速度本身是要显式设计的参数。广告排序按 pCTR×bid 分钱，5 分钟坏模型可能烧掉数百万，所以路由切换必须做成亚秒级（如蓝绿指针/canary 比例原子切换），而不是靠手动重部署。
why_en: Rollback speed is a design parameter — in ad ranking a 5-minute rollback can cost millions, so the traffic-routing switch must be sub-second (atomic blue-green pointer / canary percentage), not manual redeploy.
options: 5 分钟是可接受的标准回滚时间，广告场景也够用
回滚速度是设计参数：广告按 pCTR×bid 分钱，5 分钟坏模型可烧掉数百万，路由切换须做成亚秒级
5 分钟只是运维习惯，与架构无关，不用优化
该记住 5 分钟这个硬指标，考点就是背它
options_en: 5 minutes is an acceptable standard rollback time, fine for ads too.
Rollback speed is a design parameter: ads split money by pCTR x bid, so a 5-minute bad model can cost millions, and the routing switch must be sub-second.
5 minutes is just an ops habit, unrelated to architecture, no need to optimize.
Memorize 5 minutes as a hard number; the point is recalling it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型预测的点击率，广告拍卖里用 pCTR×bid 排序分配展示，直接决定花钱效率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pCTR (predicted Click-Through Rate) is the model's click probability; ad auctions rank by pCTR x bid, directly governing spend efficiency.

scenario: 一个团队把新模型部署上线，庆祝完成，但没有配置任何自动回滚机制。
scenario_en: A team deploys a new model, celebrates, but sets up no automated rollback mechanism.
q: 为什么说「没有回滚就不算部署完成」？
q_en: Why is a deployment 'not done' until rollback is automated?
why: 跳伞不带开伞索是致命的。三道门再严也挡不住生产才暴露的问题（欠定、分布偏移），没有自动回滚，一旦坏就只能手忙脚乱地慢慢救，爆炸半径不受控。回滚是把故障影响限制在可控范围的最后一环。
why_en: A parachute needs a ripcord — gates can't catch problems that only surface in production, so without automated rollback a failure means slow manual recovery and an uncontrolled blast radius.
options: 三道门已保证不会出问题，回滚是多余的
跳伞要带开伞索：生产才暴露的问题挡不住，没自动回滚就爆炸半径失控，回滚是限制故障影响的最后一环
回滚只对小公司有意义，大公司不需要
没回滚也没关系，出问题重训一个新模型即可
options_en: The three gates already guarantee no problems, so rollback is redundant.
A parachute needs a ripcord: production-only problems slip through, so without auto-rollback the blast radius is uncontrolled — rollback is the last line bounding failure.
Rollback only matters for small companies; big ones don't need it.
No rollback is fine; just retrain a new model if something breaks.
optionExplanations: 三道门挡不住欠定/分布偏移这类只在生产暴露的问题，不能替代回滚。
对；回滚把故障影响限制在可控范围，是安全上线不可少的最后一环。
越大规模爆炸半径越大，大公司更需要秒级回滚。
重训要几小时，救不了正在烧钱/坏体验的线上故障。
optionExplanations_en: The gates can't catch production-only problems like underspecification/drift, so they don't replace rollback.
Correct — rollback bounds failure impact, the indispensable last line of a safe launch.
Larger scale means larger blast radius, so big companies need sub-second rollback more.
Retraining takes hours and can't save a live incident already burning money or UX.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由触发条件自动把流量切回上一个良好模型的机制，限制故障爆炸半径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Automated rollback is a mechanism that auto-reverts traffic to the last good model on a trigger, bounding a failure's blast radius.

scenario: 面试官问你怎么在「上线要快」和「上线要稳」之间选部署策略。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how you choose a deployment strategy between speed and safety.
q: 部署策略选型的核心取舍轴是什么，各策略落在哪？
q_en: What's the core tradeoff axis for choosing a deployment strategy, and where does each fall?
why: 核心取舍是安全 vs 上线速度：影子最安全但信号最慢最间接；canary 平衡风险和学习（小流量拿真实信号）；蓝绿全量最快、秒回滚但成本翻倍。按场景的风险容忍度和对真实反应的需求来选。
why_en: The core tradeoff is safety vs deployment speed: shadow is safest but slowest/indirect signal, canary balances risk and learning, and blue-green is fastest full rollout with instant rollback at higher cost.
tradeoff: 安全（影子最强、canary 居中） vs 速度（蓝绿全量最快、影子最慢）
options: 核心是安全 vs 上线速度：影子最安全最慢、canary 平衡、蓝绿全量最快秒回滚但成本高
核心是模型精度 vs 参数量，与安全速度无关
核心是用什么编程语言写服务
没有取舍，永远选蓝绿就对了
options_en: The core is safety vs speed: shadow safest/slowest, canary balanced, blue-green fastest full rollout with instant rollback at higher cost.
The core is model accuracy vs parameter count, unrelated to safety/speed.
The core is which programming language the service uses.
There's no tradeoff — always pick blue-green.
whenOtherWins: 如果场景对真实用户反应几乎没需求、但对错误零容忍（反欺诈首发），天平就完全倒向安全端，选影子而非追求速度的蓝绿。
whenOtherWins_en: If a case barely needs user reaction but has zero error tolerance (a fraud first launch), the balance tips fully to safety — pick shadow, not speed-oriented blue-green.
optionExplanations: 对；安全与速度是这条选型主轴，三策略正好分布在不同位置。
精度/参数量是建模问题，不是部署策略的取舍轴。
编程语言是实现细节，与部署策略的风险-速度权衡无关。
不同场景风险容忍度不同，没有一个策略永远最优。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — safety vs speed is the main selection axis, with the three strategies at different points.
Accuracy/parameter count is a modeling question, not the deployment tradeoff axis.
Programming language is an implementation detail, unrelated to the risk-speed tradeoff.
Risk tolerance varies by case; no single strategy is always optimal.

termDefinitions.term: safety vs speed / 安全与速度权衡
termDefinitions.meaning: 部署策略的核心取舍：越安全的策略暴露真实信号越慢，越快全量的策略爆炸半径越大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The safety-vs-speed tradeoff: safer strategies surface real signal more slowly, while faster full rollouts have a larger blast radius.

q: 补全 ML 上线的三道验证门及各自时机：
q_en: Fill in the three ML deployment validation gates and their timing:
text: 训练前的 {{数据}} 验证门查 schema/漂移/泄漏；训练后的 {{模型}} 验证门对比 champion 的指标与公平性；staging 里的 {{性能}} 门查 p99 延迟/吞吐/内存。
text_en: The {{data}} gate before training checks schema/drift/leakage; the {{model}} gate after training compares champion metrics and fairness; the {{performance}} gate in staging checks p99 latency/throughput/memory.
why: 三道门按时机串联：数据门（训练前）→模型门（训练后 vs champion）→性能门（staging 压测）。各守一段，缺一段就漏一类风险。
why_en: The gates chain by timing — data before training, model after training vs champion, performance in staging — each guarding one stage.

scenario: 有人主张「先训练模型，训完再统一验证数据质量」，把数据检查挪到训练之后。
scenario_en: Someone argues to 'train first, then validate data quality afterward', moving the data check after training.
q: 为什么数据验证门必须在训练之前？
q_en: Why must the data-validation gate run before training?
why: 数据门的职责是拦坏数据进入训练。训练后再查，坏数据已经污染了模型和 eval 集，模型门也可能看不出（同源污染）。把门放训练前，才能在污染发生前挡住，避免浪费一整轮训练。
why_en: The data gate's job is to block bad data from entering training, so running it after training is too late — the corruption already tainted the model and eval set, which the model gate may miss.
tradeoff: 训练前拦（挡在污染之前、省一轮训练） vs 训练后查（已污染、可能被同源 eval 掩盖）
options: 训练后查更省事，反正模型门会兜底
数据门要在污染发生前挡住坏数据：训练后再查已污染模型和 eval，可能被同源污染掩盖，还白训一轮
数据门放训练前只是习惯，放前放后效果一样
数据验证根本不重要，可以直接跳过
options_en: Checking after training is easier; the model gate is the backstop anyway.
The data gate must block bad data before corruption: checking after training already taints the model and eval, may be masked by same-source corruption, and wastes a training run.
Putting it before training is just habit; before or after is equivalent.
Data validation isn't important and can be skipped.
whenOtherWins: 只有在数据已被独立、可信来源验证过（如上游平台已保证质量）时，才可能弱化本地数据门——但通常仍保留一道轻量校验兜底。
whenOtherWins_en: Only if data is already validated by an independent trusted source can you relax the local data gate — though a lightweight check is usually still kept as a backstop.
optionExplanations: 模型门在同源污染下兜不住，事后查也已浪费一整轮训练。
对；门放训练前才能在污染进模型之前挡住，避免同源污染掩盖和算力浪费。
位置不是习惯问题：训练后污染已发生，效果完全不同。
数据门拦的是最隐蔽的静默故障，绝不能跳过。
optionExplanations_en: The model gate can't backstop same-source corruption, and checking later already wastes a full training run.
Correct — running before training blocks corruption before it enters the model, avoiding masked corruption and wasted compute.
Position is not habit: after training the corruption already happened, so the effect differs entirely.
The data gate catches the most hidden silent failures and must not be skipped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练前对数据做 schema/漂移/泄漏检查的关卡，拦坏数据进入训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The data-validation gate runs schema/drift/leakage checks before training to block bad data from entering.

scenario: 你把新排序模型灰度到 2% 流量，需要决定盯哪些信号、稳定多久才逐步放量。
scenario_en: You canary a new ranker to 2% traffic and must decide which signals to watch and how long before ramping.
q: 灰度期间应该监控什么、以什么为放量依据？
q_en: During canary, what should you monitor and use as the ramp criterion?
why: 盯业务指标（CTR、观看时长/转化）+ 系统指标（错误率、p99），和 champion 对齐观察一段足够长的窗口（覆盖日内波动）；这些指标在置信区间内稳定才 ramp，任一显著退化就 kill 回滚。
why_en: Watch business metrics (CTR, watch time/conversion) plus system metrics (error rate, p99) against the champion over a long-enough window, ramp only when they stay within their confidence interval, and kill on any significant regression.
tradeoff: 盯业务+系统指标、够长窗口再放量（稳） vs 只看几分钟就全量（快但漏掉波动）
options: 盯业务指标(CTR/时长)+系统指标(错误率/p99)，与 champion 对比稳定一段窗口才 ramp，退化即 kill
只看新模型有没有报错，没崩就直接全量
只盯模型参数量，参数没变就放量
随便看几秒钟，越快全量越好
options_en: Watch business (CTR/watch time) + system (error rate/p99) metrics vs champion, ramp only after a stable window, kill on regression.
Only check if the new model errors; if it hasn't crashed, go full.
Only watch parameter count; if unchanged, ramp.
Glance for a few seconds; the faster to full, the better.
whenOtherWins: 如果这次改动只涉及不影响用户体验的内部重构（如等价的服务框架替换），可以主要盯系统指标、缩短业务指标观察窗口。
whenOtherWins_en: If the change is an internal refactor that can't affect UX (an equivalent serving-framework swap), you can lean on system metrics and shorten the business-metric window.
optionExplanations: 对；业务+系统指标一起盯、够长窗口稳定再放量，才是有判据的安全灰度。
不报错不代表业务指标没退化，clickbait 也不报错却伤留存。
参数量与灰度期的真实表现无关，不能当放量依据。
几秒钟盖不住日内波动，容易把偶然的好当成稳定。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — watching business plus system metrics over a long-enough window before ramping is safe, criteria-driven canary.
No errors doesn't mean business metrics held; clickbait doesn't error yet erodes retention.
Parameter count is unrelated to live canary behavior and is no ramp criterion.
A few seconds can't cover intraday variation and mistakes luck for stability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 反映产品目标的指标（CTR、观看时长、转化），灰度期用来判断新模型对用户是好是坏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Business metrics (CTR, watch time, conversion) reflect product goals and judge whether a canaried model helps or hurts users.

scenario: 两个都在数据门：一个是把答案混进了输入，一个是特征数值分布整体偏移，你要分清它们。
scenario_en: Both live at the data gate: one mixes the answer into inputs, the other shifts a feature's whole numeric distribution — tell them apart.
q: 标签泄漏和分布漂移这两种数据门问题，核心区别是什么？
q_en: What's the core difference between label leakage and distribution drift at the data gate?
why: 泄漏是「输入里混进了答案」——离线虚高、上线拿不到就崩，靠泄漏检测查特征与标签的可疑关系；漂移是「特征统计相对基线偏移」——多因上游管线问题，靠对比参考集的分布来查。一个是特征选择错，一个是数据分布变。
why_en: Leakage is an answer sneaking into inputs (inflated offline, collapses in production), caught by suspicious feature-label relationships, while drift is a feature's statistics shifting from baseline, caught by comparing to a reference set.
tradeoff: 泄漏（特征选择错、答案入输入） vs 漂移（数据分布相对基线变）
options: 泄漏是答案混进输入（离线虚高、上线崩），漂移是特征统计相对基线偏移（多因上游坏）
两者是一回事，只是叫法不同
泄漏是延迟问题，漂移是内存问题
泄漏只发生在上线后，漂移只发生在训练前
options_en: Leakage is the answer sneaking into inputs (inflated offline, collapses live); drift is a feature's statistics shifting from baseline (often upstream break).
They're the same thing under different names.
Leakage is a latency issue; drift is a memory issue.
Leakage only happens after launch; drift only before training.
optionExplanations: 对；一个是特征选择错把答案带进来，一个是数据分布偏移，成因和查法都不同。
两者本质不同：泄漏关乎特征选择，漂移关乎分布变化，不是叫法差异。
两者都是数据质量问题，与延迟/内存这类性能指标无关。
两者都主要在数据门（训练前）查，时机上不是这样割裂。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one is a feature-selection error bringing the answer in, the other a distribution shift; causes and detection differ.
They differ fundamentally: leakage is about feature selection, drift about distribution change — not naming.
Both are data-quality issues, unrelated to latency/memory performance metrics.
Both are checked mainly at the data gate (pre-training), not split that way by timing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据门里查有没有把与标签强相关或本就是答案的特征混进输入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Leakage detection checks whether a feature that is (or reveals) the answer slipped into the inputs.
